name: WipBillingReviewConsole
tagline: Stop revenue leaking between the work and the invoice.
description: A complete pre-bill WIP review app for law, accounting, consulting and engineering firms: aging and realisation dashboard, WIP list with reason-coded bulk write-downs, pro-forma review with billing-partner approval rules, billing-cycle board and entry form – in one Power Apps code component for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Forecast realisation and WIP days KPIs
Reason-coded write-downs, holds and write-offs with undo
Billing-partner approval above a write-down threshold
Drag-and-drop billing board with allowed transitions
Narrative quality flags (missing, vague, block billing)
Search, sort, group, filter, multi-select, paging for 500+ rows
Demo mode with fictional sample data
Power Fx outputs and six events
controlType: standard (2 controls: WipBillingReviewConsole data-set + WipBillingReviewConsolePortal field control)
